name: OpenVPNAccessServer
description: OpenVPN Access Server: an OpenVPN server with a web admin UI and a client portal that hands out ready-made client profiles. Official image openvpn/openvpn-as. Without a license key it allows 2 simultaneous VPN connections. Admin UI: https:// :943/admin, user openvpn. The first start generates the password and writes it to the log: Docker tab, container icon > Logs, look for "Auto-generated pass". Or on the console: docker logs OpenVPNAccessServer 2>&1 | grep "Auto-generated pass" The template uses br0, so the container gets its own IP address on your LAN. Unraid falls back to no network at all when br0 does not exist (bridging off in Network Settings): then pick bridge and change the 443 host port, which the Unraid web UI usually uses.
